audit_status.source_base: Greek Romans text tradition, draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed for judging reader, impartial judgment, Law/nations, true circumcision, inward Judean identity. Anti-Jewish misuse must be avoided.

verses.restored: Therefore you are without excuse, O human, everyone who judges; for in what you judge the other, you condemn yourself, for you who judge practice the same things.

familiar.text: Therefore thou art inexcusable, O man, whosoever thou art that judgest: for wherein thou judgest another, thou condemnest thyself; for thou that judgest doest the same things.

verses.restored: We know that the judgment of the Divine is according to truth upon those practicing such things.

familiar.text: But we are sure that the judgment of God is according to truth against them which commit such things.

verses.restored: Do you calculate this, O human, you who judge those practicing such things and do them, that you will escape the judgment of the Divine?

familiar.text: And thinkest thou this, O man, that judgest them which do such things, and doest the same, that thou shalt escape the judgment of God?

verses.restored: Or do you despise the riches of his kindness, restraint, and patience, not knowing that the kindness of the Divine leads you into turning/realignment?

familiar.text: Or despisest thou the riches of his goodness and forbearance and longsuffering; not knowing that the goodness of God leadeth thee to repentance?

verses.restored: But according to your hardness and unturned heart, you store up wrath for yourself in a day of wrath and revelation of the righteous/just judgment of the Divine,

familiar.text: But after thy hardness and impenitent heart treasurest up unto thyself wrath against the day of wrath and revelation of the righteous judgment of God;

verses.restored: who will give back to each according to one's works:

familiar.text: Who will render to every man according to his deeds:

verses.restored: to those who by endurance in good work seek glory and honor and incorruptibility, age-long life;

familiar.text: To them who by patient continuance in well doing seek for glory and honour and immortality, eternal life:

verses.restored: but to those from selfish ambition, disobeying the truth and obeying injustice, wrath and fury.

familiar.text: But unto them that are contentious, and do not obey the truth, but obey unrighteousness, indignation and wrath,

verses.restored: Pressure and distress upon every soul/life of a human working harm, Judean first and also Greek;

familiar.text: Tribulation and anguish, upon every soul of man that doeth evil, of the Jew first, and also of the Gentile;

verses.restored: but glory and honor and peace to everyone working good, Judean first and also Greek.

familiar.text: But glory, honour, and peace, to every man that worketh good, to the Jew first, and also to the Gentile:

verses.restored: For there is no partiality with the Divine.

familiar.text: For there is no respect of persons with God.

verses.restored: For as many as sinned/misaligned without Law will also perish without Law, and as many as sinned/misaligned in Law will be judged through Law.

familiar.text: For as many as have sinned without law shall also perish without law: and as many as have sinned in the law shall be judged by the law;

verses.restored: For not the hearers of Law are righteous/just before the Divine, but the doers of Law will be made righteous/just.

familiar.text: (For not the hearers of the law are just before God, but the doers of the law shall be justified.

verses.restored: For when nations who do not have Law by nature do the things of the Law, these, not having Law, are Law to themselves.

familiar.text: For when the Gentiles, which have not the law, do by nature the things contained in the law, these, having not the law, are a law unto themselves:

verses.restored: They show the work of the Law written in their hearts, their conscience bearing witness together, and their thoughts between one another accusing or even defending,

familiar.text: Which shew the work of the law written in their hearts, their conscience also bearing witness, and their thoughts the mean while accusing or else excusing one another;)

verses.restored: on the day when the Divine judges the hidden things of humans according to my good news through Messiah Jesus.

familiar.text: In the day when God shall judge the secrets of men by Jesus Christ according to my gospel.

verses.restored: But if you call yourself Judean and rest upon Law and boast in the Divine,

familiar.text: Behold, thou art called a Jew, and restest in the law, and makest thy boast of God,

verses.restored: and know the will and approve the things that differ, being instructed from the Law,

familiar.text: And knowest his will, and approvest the things that are more excellent, being instructed out of the law;

verses.restored: and are persuaded that you yourself are guide of blind ones, light of those in darkness,

familiar.text: And art confident that thou thyself art a guide of the blind, a light of them which are in darkness,

verses.restored: educator of uncomprehending ones, teacher of infants, having the embodiment of knowledge and truth in the Law—

familiar.text: An instructor of the foolish, a teacher of babes, which hast the form of knowledge and of the truth in the law.

verses.restored: you therefore who teach another, do you not teach yourself? You who proclaim not to steal, do you steal?

familiar.text: Thou therefore which teachest another, teachest thou not thyself? thou that preachest a man should not steal, dost thou steal?

verses.restored: You who say not to commit adultery, do you commit adultery? You who detest idols, do you rob temples?

familiar.text: Thou that sayest a man should not commit adultery, dost thou commit adultery? thou that abhorrest idols, dost thou commit sacrilege?

verses.restored: You who boast in Law, through transgression of the Law do you dishonor the Divine?

familiar.text: Thou that makest thy boast of the law, through breaking the law dishonourest thou God?

verses.restored: For the name of the Divine is blasphemed among the nations because of you, just as it is written.

familiar.text: For the name of God is blasphemed among the Gentiles through you, as it is written.

verses.restored: For circumcision indeed profits if you practice Law; but if you are a transgressor of Law, your circumcision has become uncircumcision.

familiar.text: For circumcision verily profiteth, if thou keep the law: but if thou be a breaker of the law, thy circumcision is made uncircumcision.

verses.restored: If therefore the uncircumcision guards the righteous/just requirements of the Law, will not that one's uncircumcision be counted as circumcision?

familiar.text: Therefore if the uncircumcision keep the righteousness of the law, shall not his uncircumcision be counted for circumcision?

verses.restored: And the uncircumcision by nature, completing the Law, will judge you who through letter and circumcision are transgressor of Law.

familiar.text: And shall not uncircumcision which is by nature, if it fulfil the law, judge thee, who by the letter and circumcision dost transgress the law?

verses.restored: For the one outwardly is not Judean, nor is circumcision outward in flesh;

familiar.text: For he is not a Jew, which is one outwardly; neither is that circumcision, which is outward in the flesh:

verses.restored: but the one inwardly is Judean, and circumcision is of heart, in Spirit, not letter, whose praise is not from humans but from the Divine.

familiar.text: But he is a Jew, which is one inwardly; and circumcision is that of the heart, in the spirit, and not in the letter; whose praise is not of men, but of God.

safety_note: Romans 2 turns the critique of Romans 1 onto the judging reader. It must not be used as anti-Jewish replacement rhetoric; Paul's argument is intra-Jewish, Torah-literate, and aimed at hypocrisy, impartial judgment, and inward covenant faithfulness.
